text:
maria: Quick heads-up — FinAP onboarding asked for an eval-triggered alerts workflow + per-model quantization recommendation API. Can we sketch a playbook and minimal launch gates this week?
raj: Clarify: alerts that fire on automated eval drift vs baseline, or also manual/customer-run tests?
maria: Both. Primary = automated eval drift (concordance drop, hit-rate drop), secondary = ad-hoc test failures flagged by CS. We need a pilot-grade response path.
olivia: Concern: alert noise. We'll need dedupe windows, rate caps, and grouping heuristics so SRE/ops don't get flooded.
tim: Suggested acceptance criteria for beta: 1) false positive rate < 10% on pilot datasets; 2) median time-to-investigation < 4h (team commitment); 3) automatic fallback to a compatible non-quantized or higher-precision variant.
alex: For Quant Recs API: return ranked profiles: [profile_id, quant_bits, est_cost_delta_pct, est_quality_delta_pct, confidence_score]. Keep payload compact for programmatic use.
maria: Pilot gate: at least one paying customer opt-in, documented playbook, UI toggle for 'auto-rollback' in Console.
deploy-bot: feature-flag enable: optimize.eval_alerts_beta ON for #product at 2025-11-04T09:12:03Z
raj: API sketch: POST /v1/optimize/recommendations {model, workload_meta, eval_set_uri} -> stream back candidate profiles with scoring. Include a small example and pagination.
olivia: Observability needs: alert provenance (eval_id, prompt_subset), sampling hook for saved outputs (redacted), and cost/latency delta estimates surfaced in Console. Retention bounded.
tim: Ops runbook skeleton: 1) receive alert -> 2) triage + run quick sliced eval -> 3) if regression confirmed, trigger auto-fallback or throttle traffic -> 4) notify CS/customer + open ticket. Add SLA commitments while in pilot.
maria: Action items: raj & alex draft API proto + example payload, olivia propose rate/dedupe rules + retention, tim author runbook checklist. Sync Thu 10:30. @here flag any customer constraints. :eyes:
raj: I'll include streaming example using chunked JSON lines and an example small eval payload.
alex: I'll prototype scoring heuristic: score = w1*quality_loss_per_token + w2*cost_delta_pct; provide calibration on 3 workloads.
olivia: Drafting dedupe: 30min grouping window per model-customer-alerttype, aggregate by signature hash, and cap alerts to 10/day per customer by default. Sample outputs retained 30 days, with opt-out.
tim: I'll put runbook into Confluence and create a minimal incident playbook for pilots with roles and contact steps.
maria: Target: beta-ready in 3 sprints assuming no infra blockers. If anything blocks, escalate here. :rocket:
